about: A Go library for reading, converting and writing subtitle files such as SRT and WebVTT.

prs.title: Subtitles keep the text after a blank line
prs.broken: When a subtitle in an SRT file had a blank line inside it, everything after that line was lost.
prs.changed: Removing empty lines at the end now stops at the last line with text, so the rest of the subtitle stays.
prs.matters: Players and tools that read SRT files show the whole subtitle.

prs.title: YouTube subtitles no longer lose the text of a cue
prs.broken: YouTube's auto-generated WebVTT files start each cue with a line holding one space. The reader took that line as the end of the cue, so the text after it was lost.
prs.changed: A line of only spaces before a cue's text is now skipped, while one after the text still ends the cue.
prs.matters: Converting YouTube captions keeps every line of text.
